title: ジャパンCの後に・跳ね返されても

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the end of their serious bout, Meisho Doto loses to T.M. Opera O. However, the two establish a rivalry at last.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O presses Meisho Doto, wondering why she's never shown this level of effort before. The two laugh together and promise to no longer hold back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This new step in their relationship also manifests in better lap times, convincing Air Shakur the two have broken past their previous stat ceiling.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's no longer certain who will emerge victorious in the race against the previous generation. The two head for the Arima Kinen as true competitors.
